data.title: Make `list` command take an optional ID
data.description: When `fleece list <id> [--next|--tree]` is run, this should show only the issue with ID <id> as well as the entire parent/child hierarchy of the issue. Add a `--parents` and `--children` flag to show one or the other as well as the selected issue, and if neither of these flags are passed in just show all issues.
